project.setTimeSignature.description: Set the song's time signature (patterns without their own follow it, as whole bars of it that hold their notes).

project.setKey.description: Set the song's key (its first note and scale), or clear it by giving neither.

tonic.description: First note of the key: 0 = C ... 11 = B

channel.add.description: Add a channel to the channel rack, by default with its own new mixer insert.

kind.description: "stock": Spinus's own or a bundled device, by stockType; "plugin": a plugin installed on this computer

stockType.description: For kind "stock": e.g. "spinus.3x-osc", "spinus.drum-machine", "spinus.eq", "bundled.dragonfly.hall" (spinus --describe all lists them)

plugin.description: For kind "plugin": the plugin as Spinus's plugin list names it (a saved project shows it)

fileOrIdentifier.description: The plugin's file, or its identifier (LV2's URI)

audioTrack.description: An audio track (no instrument; for recording and audio clips) instead of a Channel Rack channel

channel.remove.description: Remove a channel, its notes in every pattern, and automation of it.

channel.set.description: Change a channel's name, colour, volume, pan, pitch, mute, solo or group (the Channel Rack's filter group, e.g. "Drums"; empty for none), or an audio track's recording: its input, stereo, and whether it is armed.

group.description: Its group in the Channel Rack; empty for none

recordInput.description: Audio track: the sound card input it records from, from 1 (0: the input chosen in the audio settings)

recordStereo.description: Audio track: records that input and the next as a stereo pair

recordArmed.description: Audio track: Record audio records it

channel.freeze.description: Freeze a channel: its instrument is rendered to audio, which plays instead of the plugin to save CPU. Unfreeze to edit the instrument again.

frozen.description: true to freeze (the default), false to unfreeze

channel.route.description: Send a channel's output to a mixer insert.

channel.move.description: Move a channel to another position in the channel rack.

insert.addBus.description: Add a bus: a new mixer insert (after the last of them) that the given inserts play into instead of where they went; the bus plays into that place. The result has the new insert ID.

inserts.description: The inserts to play into it (IDs)

insert.remove.description: Remove a mixer insert. Channels and inserts that fed it go to master; its sends, sidechains and automation are removed.

insert.set.description: Change an insert's name, colour, icon, volume, pan, stereo width, mute or solo.

insert.move.description: Move a mixer insert to another position (routing is kept).

insert.freeze.description: Freeze a mixer insert: everything playing into it and its effects are rendered to audio, which plays instead of those plugins to save CPU. Not possible when something inside it also plays elsewhere.

frozen.description: true to freeze (the default), false to unfreeze

insert.setOutput.description: Route an insert's output to another insert (no feedback loops).

insert.setSidechain.description: Feed another insert's sound into this insert's sidechain input (for a ducker or a sidechain compressor), or remove it. No feedback loops.

source.description: Insert whose sound feeds the sidechain; leave out to remove it

insert.setNotesFrom.description: Send a channel's notes to an insert's effects as MIDI (e.g. the notes Spinus Tune pulls a voice to), or stop.

channel.description: Channel whose notes the effects receive; leave out to stop

insert.setSend.description: Add a send from one insert to another, or change its level.

insert.removeSend.description: Remove the send from one insert to another.

insert.addEffect.description: Add an effect to an insert (any number of effects). The result has the new device ID.

kind.description: "stock": Spinus's own or a bundled device, by stockType; "plugin": a plugin installed on this computer

stockType.description: For kind "stock": e.g. "spinus.3x-osc", "spinus.drum-machine", "spinus.eq", "bundled.dragonfly.hall" (spinus --describe all lists them)

plugin.description: For kind "plugin": the plugin as Spinus's plugin list names it (a saved project shows it)

fileOrIdentifier.description: The plugin's file, or its identifier (LV2's URI)

index.description: Slot position; default after the last effect

insert.removeEffect.description: Remove an effect from its insert, with its automation.

insert.moveEffect.description: Move an effect to another slot, on the same insert or another one. It keeps its settings.

insert.description: Target insert ID; default the effect's own insert

device.setParameters.description: Change settings of an instrument or effect, by the parameter ID automation uses (a Spinus device's own; for other plugins the position: 0, 1...). 'text': settings as the device shows them, "35%", "220 ms", "-6 dB", "1.2 kHz", "High pass" (by ID or name; a plain number is in the units shown, milliseconds for times, hertz for frequencies); for any plugin, read by what it shows over its range. 'values': numbers from 0 to 1 over each setting's whole range, for any device.

device.description: The instrument's or effect's device ID

values.description: Parameter ID to value, 0 to 1 over the setting's whole range

text.description: Parameter ID or setting name to its value as the device shows it ("35%", "220 ms", "1.5 s", "-6 dB", "1.2 kHz", "4:1", "30% L", "Low pass"); any plugin's too

device.loadPreset.description: Load one of 3x Osc's built-in presets: every setting of the instrument is set to the preset's ("Default": a new 3x Osc's settings). One undo step.

preset.description: The preset's name, e.g. "Reese Bass" (any case), or "Default"

insert.setEffect.description: Bypass an effect or enable it again.

pattern.clone.description: Copy a pattern with all its notes; the copy comes right after it. The result has the new pattern ID.

name.description: Name of the copy (default: the name with the next number)

clip.makeUnique.description: Give a playlist pattern clip a copy of its pattern of its own, so it can change without changing the pattern's other clips. The result has the new pattern ID.

clip.description: Clip ID (a pattern clip on the playlist)

pattern.remove.description: Remove a pattern and its clips from the playlist.

pattern.setLength.description: Set a pattern's length (its notes stay; notes past the end do not play). The next note or time signature change fits it to its notes again: whole bars, at least one.

pattern.setTimeSignature.description: Give a pattern its own time signature, or make it follow the song's by giving neither. The pattern becomes whole bars of it (at least one) that hold its notes.

pattern.set.description: Rename a pattern or change its colour.

pattern.setSwing.description: Set a pattern's swing: notes on every second Channel Rack step play later, by up to half a step at 1 (a dotted feel); 0 is straight. Notes are not moved.

pattern.setTripletSteps.description: Make a pattern's Channel Rack steps sixteenth-note triplets (six per beat) or sixteenths (four per beat, the default). Notes are not moved.

triplets.description: true for triplet steps, false for sixteenths

pattern.setNotes.description: Replace all notes of one channel in one pattern. The pattern's length follows its notes: whole bars of its time signature, at least one.

start.description: Start in ticks (960 per quarter note)

expressions.description: Per-note modulation values by name; "volume" is the per-note volume, 0-1

lane.remove.description: Remove a playlist track and the clips on it.

lane.set.description: Rename, mute, colour, group or fold a playlist track. A track grouped under another is muted and hidden (folded) with it.

group.description: The track it is grouped under (lane ID), or 0 for none

collapsed.description: Folded: the tracks grouped under it are hidden

marker.add.description: Add a named point (a marker) on the playlist's ruler, e.g. where the chorus starts. The result has the new marker ID.

clip.addPattern.description: Place a pattern on the playlist.

length.description: Length in ticks (default: the pattern's length)

offset.description: Where in the pattern to start, in ticks

clip.addAudio.description: Place an audio file on the playlist. It plays through `channel`, or through a new channel (with its own mixer insert) called `name` when no channel is given.

file.description: The audio file: relative to the project's audio/ folder, or an absolute path

channel.description: Channel to play through (default: a new one)

name.description: Name of the new channel (default: the file name)

offset.description: Where in the file to start, in ticks

clip.setAudio.description: Change an audio clip's file, volume, fades, pitch, speed or direction. A pitch or speed of its own time-stretches the clip (stretch "stretch") unless "resample" is chosen.

file.description: New audio file (relative to audio/, or absolute)

speed.description: How fast it plays: 2 = twice as fast (half as long), 0.5 = half as fast

stretch.description: off (as recorded), stretch (pitch and speed apart), stretch-drums (the same, keeping hits sharp) or resample (faster is higher, like a record)

fit.description: Keep the same audio in the clip: its length follows the new speed

clip.addTake.description: Record a take into an audio track: the first on a lane of its own, later ones on new lanes ("Take 2"...) grouped under the first take's lane. A take plays where it was recorded; the earlier takes' parts there are muted (cut where needed). The result has the new clip and lane IDs.

channel.description: The audio track (channel) the takes play through

file.description: The audio file: relative to the project's audio/ folder, or an absolute path

offset.description: Where in the file to start, in ticks

clip.useTake.description: Comping: this audio clip plays, and the other clips of its audio track (other takes) are muted where it plays, cut where they reach past it.

clip.setTune.description: Spinus Tune: replace an audio clip's tuned notes (how each sung note is moved, straightened or its vibrato changed). An empty list plays the clip as recorded.

end.description: Seconds into the clip's file (after start)

notes.description: The notes, in time order, not overlapping

clip.addAutomation.description: Add an automation clip: a curve for one parameter (a channel's or insert's volume or pan, or a device parameter by its ID). Without `lane`, it goes on a new lane at the bottom called `laneName`.

kind.description: channelVolume and channelPan need channel; insertVolume and insertPan need insert; deviceParameter needs device and parameterId

channel.description: Channel ID, for channelVolume and channelPan

insert.description: Mixer insert ID, 1 for the master, for insertVolume and insertPan

parameterId.description: The setting's ID as spinus --describe lists it, for deviceParameter

value.description: 0..1 of the parameter's range (scripts run with spinus --run may give "text" instead: "-6 dB", "1.2 kHz")

curve.description: Shape of the segment that starts here; 0 = straight

points.description: The curve's points, at least one

clip.setPoints.description: Replace the points of an automation clip.

value.description: 0..1 of the parameter's range (scripts run with spinus --run may give "text" instead: "-6 dB", "1.2 kHz")

curve.description: Shape of the segment that starts here; 0 = straight

points.description: The curve's points, at least one

clip.set.description: Move, resize, mute or re-offset a playlist clip.

clip.split.description: Cut a playlist clip in two at a song time (ticks). The second part is a new clip that plays on from there; its ID is in the result.

at.description: Where to cut, in song ticks (inside the clip)

clip.add.description: Place a playlist clip given whole, in the project file's format (without id): a pattern, audio or automation clip with all its settings. The new clip's ID is in the result.

clip.description: The clip, as project.json writes it

launcher.addTrack.description: Add a clip launcher track (a column of slots).

launcher.removeTrack.description: Remove a clip launcher track and the clips in it.

launcher.setTrack.description: Rename a clip launcher track or change its colour.

launcher.addScene.description: Add a clip launcher scene (a row of slots).

launcher.removeScene.description: Remove a clip launcher scene and the clips in it.

launcher.addPattern.description: Put a pattern in a clip launcher slot (replacing what is there). Launched, it plays on the pattern's channels, looped over `length`.

length.description: Length of one pass in ticks (default: the pattern's length)

loop.description: Loop (default true); false plays it once

launcher.addAudio.description: Put an audio file in a clip launcher slot (replacing what is there). It plays through `channel`, or through a new channel (with its own mixer insert) called `name` when no channel is given.

file.description: The audio file: relative to the project's audio/ folder, or an absolute path

length.description: Length of one pass in ticks

channel.description: Channel to play through (default: a new one)

name.description: Name of the new channel (default: the file name)

offset.description: Where in the file to start, in ticks

loop.description: Loop (default true); false plays it once

launcher.setClip.description: Move a clip launcher clip to another slot (replacing what is there), or change its length or looping.

track.description: Launcher track to move it to

length.description: Length of one pass in ticks

launcher.setQuantize.description: When launched clips start: at once, on the next beat or on the next bar.
